title: CPO Trading Analytics
thesis: Snowflake unifies trading, logistics, and market data — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time position books, ML.FORECAST projects CPO price curves, and Cortex AI synthesizes market intelligence from 300+ trade documents

talking_points: Net long 45,000 tonnes CPO across Q1-Q2 delivery — mark-to-market gain of Rp 23 billion.
Two counterparties at 85% of credit limit — approaching breach threshold.
Export levy at US$52/tonne eroding 3.1% from gross margin this quarter.
show: Point at net position and MTM KPI
Highlight counterparties near limit in amber
tabs.call_out: Net long 45,000t — Rp 23B MTM gain, 2 counterparties near limit

transition.line: Let's look at the forward curve and price outlook.

talking_points: BMD CPO futures in backwardation — prompt month at MYR 4,200 vs Q3 at MYR 3,950.
ML.FORECAST projects price recovery to MYR 4,400 by Q2 — seasonal demand factor.
Physical premium at US$45/tonne FOB Belawan — widening vs Rotterdam CIF.
show: Show forward curve chart with ML forecast overlay
tabs.call_out: ML projects MYR 4,400 Q2 — seasonal demand signal

transition.line: Price outlook supports current position. Let's check logistics risk.

talking_points: Three vessels delayed at Belawan Port — total exposure 12,000 tonnes, demurrage accruing.
VaR at 95% confidence: Rp 8.7 billion — within approved limit of Rp 12 billion.
Basis risk between BMD and physical widening — hedging effectiveness at 87%.
show: Show vessel tracker with delay flags
tabs.call_out: 3 vessels delayed — Rp 8.7B VaR within limits

transition.line: Now let the Head of Trading ask the system directly.

talking_points: Harianto asks: 'What's our net CPO position and mark-to-market?'
Cortex Analyst queries position book — returns net long 45,000t with Rp 23B gain.
Follow-up: 'Generate market commentary for today's trading desk brief' — AI produces narrative.
show: Switch to advisory mode for market commentary
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: trading analytics + market intelligence advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, real-time position management.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
Kinesis replaced by Snowpipe Streaming; SageMaker by ML.FORECAST.
Indonesia exported US$28.5B in palm oil in 2023. This manages a Rp 44T trading book.
tabs.call_out: One platform, real-time positions, native ML for price forecasting

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for commodity trading.
